_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: every letter moves the same way, straight down or one box along; 2: down and to the right, or across the middle line like a mirror within one pair of groups; 3: the mirror found between the 1st and 3rd groups and used on the 2nd, a letter that stays in the middle, or a move towards the middle; 4: two different moves in one group, or a rule read from the groups alone. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
